title: Optimized split-provider end-to-end Richards timing
question: When the split representation is implemented without redundant analytical C/K work, does it reduce complete Richards solve cost while retaining the F-AHL04C fidelity result?
candidate: exact authoritative theta(h); adaptive lookup C(h),K(h) for h<=-1 cm; authoritative analytical provider for h>-1 cm
decision_rule: Advance only if all fidelity gates pass and median complete-solve CPU is lower than analytical. Do not infer whole-SWAP speedup from this fixture.
